# 00000000544

**CA-44 ★** — source: 21_交换代数与同调代数.md

**English.** Definition: The Graver basis of the toric ideal I_{A_G} generated by the incidence matrix A_G of a graph G consists of all irreducible elements of its lattice. Conjecture: For all graphs without isolated vertices, |Graver(I_{A_G})| ≤ Σ_{H⊆G, H forest} 2^{|V(H)|}, with equality on forests.

**中文。** 定义：图 G 的关联矩阵 A_G 生成的 toric 理想 I_{A_G} 的 Graver 基为其格中全部不可约元。猜想：对一切无孤立点图,|Graver(I_{A_G})| ≤ Σ_{H⊆G, H 林} 2^{|V(H)|},且该上界在森林图上取等。
